companyDescription: Quantum computing · Photonic quantum hardware (Dirac systems) and foundry (Luminar Semiconductor acquisition) — $1.4B cash chest funding an aggressive build-out into the 2026 'quantum advantage' narrative
priceNote: Live $6.50 (+1.0%) on Nov 4, 2026 — down ~16% from $7.72 at the Aug 4 report, near the $6.08 52-week low (high $14.45). Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Aug 4, 2026): Q3 2026 results are expected ~Nov 9-13 (not company-confirmed; MarketBeat cites Nov 9 after the close). Consensus is ~-$0.04 EPS on ~$7.6M revenue after Q2's $5.55M beat. The ~$1.4B cash chest makes survival a non-issue, but that cash is ~70% of a ~$2.0B market cap, and the Street's own $8.50 Hold consensus implies only ~+31%. There is no dated binary that could plausibly triple a $2B photonics company in this window, so Base is cut from +45% to +30% and Moon to the +200% turbo floor (~$19.50, above the $14.45 52-week high). This is a cash-backed quantum option, not a moonshot. Base is above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; written-Base bias +72.7pp) and assumes Q3 revenue growth plus foundry orders over ~1-3 months. แนะนำ 1% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 30-40%.
